metadata.name: GetSpendRule
metadata.description: This API is used to get the Spend Rule applied on the Card.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 1234

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: TransactionType
children.description: This tag will return the type of transaction defined for the Spend Rule.The Spend Rules will be applied for this type of Transaction. Valid Values:1=Cash Access,2=Online,3=PIN POS Transaction,4=Signature POS Transaction,5=Contactless Transactions,6=Recurring Transactions,7= Card Not present Transactions Format: X Example:1

children.name: TransactionCategory
children.description: Use this tag to define the transaction category. Valid Values:1=All, 2=Domestic,3=International, Format: X Example:1

children.name: TransactionAllowed
children.description: Use this tag to define whether Transaction Allowed will be yes or Not Valid Values: 0 = No / 1 = Yes Format: X Example:1

children.name: CardType
children.description: Use this tag to define the Card Type Valid Values:1=Primary,2=Seconday,3=Al Format: X Example:1

children.name: SingleTransactionLimit
children.description: Use this tag to provide the single transaction limit Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example:10

children.name: DefaultValueonCard
children.description: Use this tag to provide the default value on card Valid Values: 0 = No / 1 = Yes Format: X Example:1

children.name: DailySpendLimitCount
children.description: Use this tag to update daily spend limit count. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example:10

children.name: DailySpendLimitAmount
children.description: Use this tag to update daily spend limit amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example:500

children.name: WeeklySpendLimitCount
children.description: Use this tag to update Weekly spend limit count. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example:10

children.name: WeeklySpendLimitAmount
children.description: Use this tag to update Weekly spend limit amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example:500

children.name: MonthlySpendLimitCount
children.description: Use this tag to update Monthly spend limit count. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example:10

children.name: MonthlySpendLimitAmount
children.description: Use this tag to update Monthly spend limit amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example:500

children.name: YearlySpendLimitCount
children.description: Use this tag to update Yearly spend limit count. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example:10

children.name: YearlySpendLimitAmount
children.description: Use this tag to update Yearly spend limit amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example:500

children.name: Status
children.description: Use this tag to provide the status of the Spend rule, whether it is Active or Inactive Valid Values:1=Active, 2=Inactive Format: X Example:1
